item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 22 (park): The map notes' lookup of the retired 1998…
item.description: The map notes' lookup of the retired 1998 'COMMON_AREAS' placeholder parcel now cites its DataSF row (blklot 8799TBA3, mapped 1998-07-01, dropped 2005-09-19). UCSF's June 2025 CAC presentation map labels a park 'KORET QUAD (22)' (and OCII's November 2024 CAC map is reported to label a completed park 'Koret Quad') at this block, which would contradict 'not a formally named park'; nothing about the block's name, status or geometry was changed because the match has not been confirmed, and the record's open questions and map notes now say so. The NAIP credit names the USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, which the data.gov record names as NAIP's administrator, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural. Source: DataSF Parcels (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Parcels-Active-and-Retired/acdm-wktn); UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); OCII, Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update, Mission Bay CAC, 2024-11-14 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf); USDA NAIP Imagery catalog record (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip-imagery); Wikimedia Commons file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 22 (park): Mission Bay South Block 22 (park): status…
item.description: Mission Bay South Block 22 (park): status corrected from 'planned' to 'complete'. The block had been registered as a future park based on satellite imagery (a landscaped lawn with trees, no dirt, no structure), which fits either a finished small park or an interim-landscaped future site; that ambiguity should have been flagged as a question rather than resolved by assumption. An on-site visit confirmed the park is complete. A follow-up DataSF Assessor parcel and building-footprint check found no structure on the site and traced the main underlying parcel to a retired 1998 'COMMON_AREAS' placeholder plus edge fragments of the scattered UCSF campus parcel. That is consistent with open land, but it was the on-site visit, not this lookup, that settled 'complete' over 'planned'. (The retired parcel is DataSF Parcels blklot 8799TBA3, mapped 1998-07-01 and dropped 2005-09-19; read 2026-09-29.) Source: DataSF Parcels - Active and Retired, retired blklot 8799TBA3 (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); DataSF Building Footprints (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Building-Footprints/ynuv-fyni).
